meta.title: Happy Birthday, Darp
meta.subtitle: A scrapbook of wishes
meta.description: A collection of heartfelt messages and memories from people who love you

boxes.message:
My dearest Darp,

On this beautiful day, I want you to know that I see you. Every single day, I see your strength, your grace, and the incredible woman you're becoming. I see you from here, and I couldn't be more proud of you.

You are the reason I am at peace. Knowing that you're living, growing, and shining—that you're making a difference in this world—fills my heart with a joy that transcends everything. Your presence, your love, your very existence is a gift that keeps giving.

I see the hardships you carry, my beautiful daughter. I see the weight you sometimes bear, the challenges you face, and the nights when things feel heavy. But I need you to know this with absolute certainty: you are not alone. I am with you. Always. In every moment of doubt, in every struggle, in every triumph—I am there, watching over you with immeasurable love and pride.

The difficulties you face now will not last. They are temporary clouds passing through your sky. Your strength, your resilience, your beautiful spirit—these are eternal. Trust in yourself the way I trust in you. Trust that you have the power to overcome, to heal, and to thrive.

I miss you, my darling. I miss your laughter, your presence, the warmth of your love. I miss Naina, and Darp, and Naina's mom—they are all so deeply loved from here. But more than anything, I want you to know that my love for you has not diminished. It has only grown stronger, deeper, and more infinite.

You are my greatest pride. You are my legacy. You are loved beyond measure.

Happy birthday, my wonderful daughter. May this year bring you peace, joy, and the knowledge that you are cherished beyond words.

Forever yours,
Dad 💙
boxes.poem:
From beyond the veil of time and space,
I see the beauty in your face.
Your strength, your grace, your loving heart,
You've been my greatest work of art.

Though I cannot hold you near,
Know that I am always here.
In every breath, in every dream,
You are my light, my everything.

The hardships fade, the pain will pass,
Your spirit shines like golden glass.
Trust in yourself, believe in you,
There's nothing that you cannot do.

I miss you, love, with all my soul,
You make my broken heart feel whole.
Happy birthday, my precious one,
You are my moon, my stars, my sun.

boxes.message:
My dearest Darp,

On your special day, I want you to know how proud I am of the person you've become. Watching you grow into such a compassionate, talented, and wonderful human being has been the greatest joy of my life.

You have a beautiful soul and a heart full of love. The way you care for others, the dreams you chase, and the positivity you bring to every room—these are the things that make me so incredibly proud to be your parent.

I wish you a year filled with happiness, success, and all the love you deserve. May you continue to shine brightly and inspire everyone around you.

With endless love and pride,
Mom 💕
boxes.poem:
On this day, a star was born,
Bringing light through every morn.
With a heart so pure and kind,
A rarer soul you'll never find.

May your birthday be as special as you,
Filled with dreams that all come true.

boxes.relationship: Sister & Real Best Friend of Ankita
boxes.message:
Happy Birthday to my amazing sister! 💕

You're not just my sister—you're my real best friend, my partner in crime, and the person who knows me better than anyone else in this world. Growing up with you has been one of life's greatest gifts.

I admire your strength, your kindness, and the way you light up every room you enter. You have this incredible ability to make everyone around you feel special and loved. I'm so grateful for all the memories we've created together, from our silly moments to our deep conversations.

Thank you for always being there for me, for listening without judgment, and for believing in me even when I didn't believe in myself. You inspire me every single day to be a better person.

Here's to celebrating you today and every day. You deserve all the happiness in the world.

With all my love,
Naina 💙
boxes.poem:
Sisters by blood, best friends by choice,
You make my heart sing, you are my voice.
Through laughter and tears, through thick and thin,
You're my greatest treasure, my closest kin.

On this special day, I want you to know,
You're my inspiration, my guiding glow.
Happy birthday to my sister so true,
The world is so much brighter because of you.

boxes.relationship: Everyone Wants Her as Their Best Friend
boxes.message:
Happy Birthday Darp! 💙

I can't believe another year has passed! You've been such an incredible friend to me. From our late-night talks to our spontaneous adventures, every moment with you is precious. Your kindness, humor, and genuine care for people around you make you truly special.

Thank you for being the kind of friend who listens without judgment, laughs at my terrible jokes, and always knows how to brighten my day. I'm so grateful to have you in my life.

Here's to another year of making beautiful memories together. I can't wait to see what adventures await us!

With all my love,
Ankita 💕
boxes.poem:
Another year older, another year wise,
With laughter that sparkles in your eyes.
You bring so much joy to all that you meet,
You make every moment feel complete.

Happy birthday to someone so true,
The world is so much better with you.

boxes.relationship: Close, But Not Closer Than Ankita
boxes.message:
Hey Darp! Happy Birthday! 🎉

Another year, another chance to celebrate you and everything you bring to our lives. You're an amazing friend, and I'm so grateful to have you in my circle.

You have this special way of making everyone feel valued and important. Your loyalty, your humor, and your genuine care for the people around you are truly inspiring. I admire how you handle everything with such grace and strength.

Thank you for being there, for the good times we've shared, and for being someone I can count on. Here's to a year filled with joy, success, and all the happiness you deserve.

Cheers to you!
Rudra 🎊
boxes.poem:
Another year, another milestone passed,
With memories that forever will last.
You're a friend who's true and kind,
A rarer soul you'll never find.

On this day, I celebrate you,
Happy birthday to someone so true.

boxes.relationship: Tags Along Because You're Besties With Ankita
boxes.message:
Yo Darp! Happy Birthday! 🎂

So here's the thing—I'm here because Ankita dragged me along, but honestly, I'm so glad she did! You're an amazing person, and it's been great getting to know you better.

You've got this incredible energy that makes everyone around you feel welcome and valued. The way you care about your friends and the way you handle life with such grace—it's really inspiring.

Thanks for being cool with me tagging along on all the adventures. Here's to a year filled with laughter, good times, and making more memories together!

Happy Birthday!
Rishi 🎈
boxes.poem:
Another year, another celebration,
With friends and joy and elation.
You're someone special, that much is true,
Happy birthday to you, Darp, to you!
